evidence.snippet: 법무부, LA카운티에 "비시민권자 의심 투표용지 개표 시 연방 범죄 방조" 경고 [공부의여신 네트워크] 트럼프 대통령이 트루스소셜에 트렌트 맥코터 법무차관 대행 명의의 10월 16일 자 법무부 서한을 공개했다. 이 서한은 LA카운티 법률자문실의 10월 15일 자 답신을 정면으로 반박하는 내용이다. 법무부는 10월 13일 연방기관이 비시민권자 유권자 등록 의심자로 판단한 2만 명 이상의 명단을 카운티에 넘겼다며, 시민권 확인 전까지 해당 투표용지를 임시로 분리 보관하라고 요구했다. 법무부는 투표용지 분리가 "법적으로 금지"라는 카운티의 주장이 틀렸다고 반박하며, 비시민권자 투표는 연방 범죄이고 이를 알면서 개표하면 방조범이 될 수 있다고 경고했다. 또 캘리포니아의 자기신고식 등록 제도, 선거 직전 90일 명부 정리를 금지한 전국유권자등록법 조항, 행정적 부담 등은 위법 개표의 이유가 될 수 없다고 못 박았다. 법무부는 카운티와 주 국무장관실에 입장을 재고하라고 강하게 촉구하며, 그렇지 않으면 연방 차원의 조사와 법적 책임에 직면할 수 있다고 밝혔다.

items.original_title: FinancialJuice: ING: The USD

evidence.headline: FinancialJuice: ING: The USD
evidence.snippet: The sell-off on Coreweave assets saw a modest reversal yesterday after Nvidia's CEO, Jensen Huang, said that Coreweave's financial strength was improving and its cost of capital was declining. Perhaps those comments should not be surprising from a major shareholder in Coreweave; let's see how long this bounce in Coreweave assets lasts. The big takeaway this week has been the recovery of the long-end of the US Treasury market, even as inflation data continues to come in hot. Here it seems that investors are starting to find value in long-dated Treasuries and are viewing those as a middling hedge against a correction in the AI trade. Were the tech sell-off to gain momentum, that Treasury buying would move to the shorter end of the curve. While fears of an AI correction may be growing, inflation data continues to come in hot. Yesterday it was US September PPI data blowing away consensus. And today, import prices should come in near 8% year-on-year, the highest since summer 2022. Inflation data is keeping short-dated interest rates supported and has delivered a near 20bp flattening in the 2-10 year Treasury curve this week. What does that mean for FX? Typically, an environment where the Fed is applying the brakes while growth prospects are being revised down is good for the dollar against activity and emerging market currencies. It is only when short end rates break lower that the dollar is ready to drop. And we are not there yet.

items.original_title: FinancialJuice: Goldman Sachs: European Energy

evidence.headline: FinancialJuice: Goldman Sachs: European Energy
evidence.snippet: European fuel prices have risen much more than crude oil as refining margins widened sharply, raising questions about forecasting fuel inflation beyond timely pump data and the implications for the inflation outlook. We reassess the pass-through from oil and natural gas prices into Euro area inflation. Rolling-window estimates suggest that a 10% rise in crude oil now raises headline inflation by 18bp through fuels, versus 13bp historically, while a 10% rise in TTF adds around 5bp through electricity and gas, versus 8bp historically. The composition of transmission has shifted towards oil, but the aggregate headline sensitivity to a 10% energy shock remains 30bp. As a result, we still expect Euro area energy HICP to peak at 18%yoy and headline inflation at 3.8%yoy in 2026Q4. We also update our fuel inflation forecast by directly incorporating product spreads and modelling fuel taxes separately. Our updated models point to a faster normalisation of fuel price pressures in 2027 and thus a bigger negative base effect further out. We therefore now forecast headline inflation of 2.7% in 2027 (vs 3.0% previously) and 1.9%yoy in 2028.
